media-scrubber._comment: Tokens for <OrigamMediaScrubber>. Reusable slider used by both the video scrubber AND the volume control inside <OrigamMediaController>. Track + buffer + progress + thumb + hover-tooltip surfaces.
media-scrubber._comment-flat: track-*/buffer-*/thumb-* below are FLAT (top-level, no hyphen-safe grouping needed) because OrigamMediaScrubber.vue reads them as flat names, not as `track`/`buffer`/`thumb` BEM children — nesting them (as this file used to) silently produced --origam-media-scrubber__track---*, a name the component never reads (issue #505, the mechanism inverse of #435: a split property emitted in BEM form when the component reads it flat). Only the 5 properties actually read as token sources are kept; the component also declares LOCAL synthesis vars (`--…---track-thickness`, `--…---track-bg`, `--…---thumb-size`) seeded FROM these — those are CSS-level lets, not tokens, and need no backing entry here.

tooltip._comment: Floating hover tooltip used when showHoverTooltip=true. Horizontal orientation only. Uses neutral primitives directly because the DS has no semantic `surface.inverse` token yet — the contrast pair (neutral.900 bg + neutral.0 fg) matches what OrigamTooltip does elsewhere.
